description: Save an activity (subtask) you can log time on as a favorite for quick reuse, under the name you give it. Returns the created favorite.

customer_id.description: Optional. Customer id; taken from the subtask when omitted, and must match it when given.

display_name.description: Short label for the favorite (e.g. 'Daily standup on Acme'), max 200 characters.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

project_id.description: Optional. Project id; taken from the subtask when omitted, and must match it when given.

sub_task_id.description: Id of the activity (subtask) to save. Look it up with find_billing_work; never guess it.

task_id.description: Optional. Task id; taken from the subtask when omitted, and must match it when given.

name: create_favorite
title: Create favorite
